verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation or community testimony specifically describing Unreal's rigid-body physics, collision system, or raycasting APIs working out of the box; the only tangential physics-related remark (unreal-comm-7) discusses realism of hair/ponytail simulation, not rigid-body/collision/raycast functionality. Missing for 10: any docs on Chaos Physics/PhysX, collision channels, or line-trace/raycast APIs, and any hands-on confirmation they work by default.
